$\mathcal{E} = \{x : x \text{ is an integer and } 1 \le x \le 15\}$
$A = \{x : x \text{ is a multiple of } 3\}$
$B = \{x : x \text{ is a factor of } 30\}$
syllabus_check: 4052 Set language and notation: listing the elements of a set defined by a rule, intersection, complement, and the number of elements in a set, with $A' \cap B'$ recognised as the complement of the union. Two 1-mark parts; no Venn diagram is required, so needs_figure is false.
originality_note: Sets are defined by rules (multiples of 3, factors of 30 within 1 to 15) rather than by a Venn diagram of region counts or a shading task, so it shares no structure with the exemplars; part (b) tests De Morgan's law through counting. Shares no context with Q1-Q6.
